## What's Changed
* Add CodSpeed performance benchmarks and CI by @codspeed-hq[bot] in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/254
* Redesign floating table of contents with hover previews and outline panel (#257) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/257
* CI improvements and macOS DMG background  [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/267
* Add note-subfolder attachment storage mode for pasted images by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/272
* Add non-Markdown file visibility setting by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/273
* Add corner radius control and refine appearance settings UI by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/274
* Restyle wiki link affordance by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/277
* Add customizable theme colors by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/278
* Persist main window geometry across launches by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/283
* Move SQLite index out of space folder to app support (KAR-59) by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/280
* Add user-facing spell check setting for editors by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/284
* Polish appearance theme settings and add new themes (#286) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/286
* Add file tree sort modes for name, modified, created (#288) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/288
* Add Print Note via system print sheet for PDF export by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/289
* Add sandboxed HTML/SVG embed previews in the editor by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/290
* Switch toast notifications from Sonner to Sileo (#293) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/293
* Route space errors through toasts and add dismiss control (#296) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/296
